kjv: I would they were even cut off which trouble you
mine: I wish those who unsettle you would go all the way and emasculate themselves
note: apokopsontai (middle) means to castrate oneself, a bitter jibe at those demanding circumcision; "cut off" reads as excommunication.
TR adds "moicheia"; absent from Sinaiticus*, A, B, C. Also 5:21 TR adds "murders" (phonoi), absent from P46, Sinaiticus, B.
pistis in a list of virtues is faithfulness, not belief; "chrestotes" is kindness, and the KJV's "gentleness" here duplicates its "meekness" (prautes) in 5:23.
